english: How do I activate international roaming on my mobile postpaid connection?
tamil_english: Ennoda mobile postpaid connection-la international roaming eppadi activate panrathu?
hindi_english: Mere mobile postpaid connection par international roaming kaise activate karu?

english: What documents are required for outward foreign currency wire transfers?
tamil_english: Outward foreign currency wire transfers anuppa enna documents thevai?
hindi_english: Outward foreign currency wire transfers ke liye kaunse documents required hain?

english: What is the procedure for converting a physical SIM card to an eSIM?
tamil_english: Oru physical SIM card-ai eSIM-aaga maatra procedure enna?
hindi_english: Physical SIM card ko eSIM mein convert karne ka procedure kya hai?

english: What is the daily UPI transaction limit for a bank account?
tamil_english: Oru bank account-la daily UPI transaction limit evvalavu?
hindi_english: Bank account mein UPI ka daily limit kitna hai?
ground_truth: The standard daily UPI limit is INR 1,00,000 per bank account per 24-hour cycle.

english: How can I temporarily freeze my lost debit card?
tamil_english: Ennoda kaabadu pona debit card-ai eppadi temporarily freeze pannuvathu?
hindi_english: Mera debit card kho gaya, use temporarily freeze kaise karun?
ground_truth: Use the mobile banking app under Cards > Security Controls > Temporary Freeze, or send SMS 'BLOCK <Last 4 Digits>' to 567676.

english: What is the minimum average balance required for an urban savings account?
tamil_english: Urban savings account-ku minimum average balance enna maintain pananum?
hindi_english: Urban savings account ke liye minimum average balance kitna chahiye?
ground_truth: Urban and metro branch savings accounts require a monthly average balance (MAB) of INR 10,000.

english: What is the zero liability policy for unauthorized electronic transactions?
tamil_english: Unauthorized electronic transaction-ku zero liability policy epdi work aagum?
hindi_english: Unauthorized electronic transaction ke liye zero liability policy kya hai?
ground_truth: If an unauthorized transaction is reported within 3 working days, the customer has zero liability and the amount is provisionally credited back within 10 working days.

english: What is the maximum annual household income limit to be eligible for a microfinance loan?
tamil_english: Microfinance loan paiya oru kudumbathoda maximum annual income evvalavu irukkanum?
hindi_english: Microfinance loan ke liye household ka maximum annual income kitna hona chahiye?
ground_truth: A household with annual income up to Rs 3,00,000 is eligible for a microfinance loan.

english: What is the maximum repayment period allowed for a microfinance loan?
tamil_english: Microfinance loan repayment period maximum evvalavu months irukkum?
hindi_english: Microfinance loan ka maximum repayment period kitne months ka hai?
ground_truth: The maximum repayment period is 36 months, with an allowable moratorium period of up to 2 months.

english: What percentage of monthly household income is the limit for loan repayment obligations?
tamil_english: Monthly household income-la enna percentage loan repayment-ku limit vaikkurathu?
hindi_english: Monthly household income ka kitna percent loan repayment obligations ka limit hai?
ground_truth: The total monthly loan repayment obligations of a household (including all loans) cannot exceed 50% of the monthly household income.

english: Is there a pre-payment penalty on microfinance loans?
tamil_english: Microfinance loan early close pannina enna penalty irukka?
hindi_english: Microfinance loan ko early close karne par koi penalty lagegi kya?
ground_truth: There is no pre-payment penalty on microfinance loans. Penalty for delayed payment is applied only on the overdue amount, not the entire loan.

english: Is collateral required to take a microfinance loan from the bank?
tamil_english: Bank-la microfinance loan eduka collateral venuma?
hindi_english: Bank se microfinance loan lene ke liye koi collateral chahiye kya?
ground_truth: Microfinance loans are collateral-free. They shall not be linked with a lien on the deposit account of the borrower.

english: What repayment frequency options are available for microfinance borrowers?
tamil_english: Microfinance borrowers enna enna repayment frequency options choose pannalaam?
hindi_english: Microfinance borrowers ke liye repayment frequency ke kya options available hain?
ground_truth: Repayment frequency can be weekly, fortnightly, or monthly based on the borrower's income profile.

english: What information must a bank include in the loan card provided to microfinance borrowers?
tamil_english: Microfinance borrower-ku kudukka vendiya loan card-la enna information irukkaanum?
hindi_english: Microfinance borrower ko diye gaye loan card mein kya information hona chahiye?
ground_truth: The loan card must include borrower identification, simplified factsheet on pricing, all terms and conditions, repayment acknowledgements, and grievance redressal details including nodal officer contact.

english: What practices are considered harsh and prohibited in microfinance loan recovery?
tamil_english: Microfinance loan recovery-la enna actions harsh-aa consider panranga?
hindi_english: Microfinance loan recovery mein kaunsi practices harsh aur prohibited mani jati hain?
ground_truth: Harsh recovery practices include threatening language, calling before 9am or after 6pm, harassing relatives, publishing borrower names, use of violence, or misleading the borrower about the debt.

english: Can a bank change the interest rate on an existing microfinance loan mid-tenure?
tamil_english: Bank oru microfinance loan interest rate-aa loan period-la change pannalama?
hindi_english: Kya bank ek existing microfinance loan ka interest rate tenure ke beech mein change kar sakta hai?
ground_truth: Any change in interest rate must be informed to the borrower well in advance and the change is effective only prospectively, not retroactively.

english: If a gold-hypothecated loan exists, can the household still get a microfinance loan?
tamil_english: Gold hypothecation loan iruntha, anththa household innum microfinance loan edukka mudiyuma?
hindi_english: Agar gold hypothecation loan hai, to kya woh household microfinance loan le sakta hai?
ground_truth: Loans backed by hypothecation (e.g., gold, equipment) are not classified as microfinance loans and would count toward the 50% repayment obligation cap.

english: What does the SBI Code of Ethics stand for with respect to its core values?
tamil_english: SBI Code of Ethics-la solla padra core values enna?
hindi_english: SBI Code of Ethics mein core values kya hain?
ground_truth: SBI's core values are summarised by STEPS: Service, Transparency, Ethics, Politeness, and Sustainability.

english: What is the SBI bank's vision statement?
tamil_english: SBI bank-oda vision statement enna?
hindi_english: SBI bank ka vision statement kya hai?
ground_truth: SBI's vision is 'Be the Bank of Choice for a Transforming India'.

english: What actions are prohibited under the SBI anti-bribery and anti-corruption guidelines?
tamil_english: SBI anti-bribery guidelines padiya enna enna paninkooda kathadhu?
hindi_english: SBI anti-bribery guidelines mein kya kya actions prohibited hain?
ground_truth: Employees must never accept or give bribes, must report any bribe offered, and should not facilitate or tolerate bribery or corruption in any form.

english: What are the gift acceptance limits for SBI officers in Scale V?
tamil_english: SBI Scale V officers enna enna gifts accept pannalaam? Limit evvalavu?
hindi_english: SBI Scale V officers ke liye gift accept karne ki limit kya hai?
ground_truth: Officers up to Scale V can accept gifts from near relatives (on occasions like weddings) only if the value does not exceed Rs 15,000 per occasion, and this must be reported.

english: What does the SBI code say about using bank resources for political purposes?
tamil_english: Bank resources-aa political purposes-ku use panna SBI code enna solranga?
hindi_english: Political purposes ke liye bank resources use karne par SBI code kya kehta hai?
ground_truth: Employees must be apolitical and must not use bank's time or resources for any political purposes.

english: What does the SBI code say about sharing customer information?
tamil_english: Customer information share panna SBI code enna restrict panranga?
hindi_english: SBI code customer information share karne ke baare mein kya kehta hai?
ground_truth: Customer information must not be used for any purpose outside the bank's business. Accessing information 'out of curiosity' is also a breach of confidentiality.

english: What is the non-retaliation commitment stated in the SBI Code of Ethics?
tamil_english: SBI Code of Ethics-la non-retaliation commitment epdi explain panranga?
hindi_english: SBI Code of Ethics mein non-retaliation commitment kya hai?
ground_truth: The bank strictly prohibits any retaliation or intimidation against employees who report legitimate concerns. Anyone who victimises such a person faces strict disciplinary action.

english: What actions does the SBI code mandate for reporting suspicious transactions under AML guidelines?
tamil_english: AML guidelines padiya suspicious transactions find pannina enna panna solranga SBI code-la?
hindi_english: AML guidelines mein suspicious transaction milne par SBI code kya karne ko kehta hai?
ground_truth: Employees must read and follow KYC/AML/CFT guidelines, report suspicious transactions promptly, exercise due diligence, and must not tip off any person who is the subject of a suspicious transaction report.

english: What is the Cash and Cheque Collection product offered by SBI Transaction Banking?
tamil_english: SBI Transaction Banking-la Cash and Cheque Collection product epdi work aaguthu?
hindi_english: SBI Transaction Banking mein Cash and Cheque Collection product kaise kaam karta hai?
ground_truth: It collects receivables (Cash and Cheque) from corporates into a centralized pooling account, provides customized MIS, and offers Cash Pickup with insurance for Cash in Transit.

english: What is the maximum cash deposit allowed per day per branch using the Power Jyoti product?
tamil_english: Power Jyoti product use pannina per day per branch maximum cash deposit evvalavu pannalaam?
hindi_english: Power Jyoti product mein ek branch mein ek din mein maximum kitna cash deposit kar sakte hain?
ground_truth: The maximum deposit is Rs 3 lakh per day per branch, though the Branch Manager may permit more.

english: How does the E-Mandate product differ from traditional Mandate Based Collection?
tamil_english: E-Mandate product traditional Mandate Collection-la irundhu enna differ aaguthu?
hindi_english: E-Mandate product traditional Mandate Based Collection se kaise alag hai?
ground_truth: E-Mandate is the digital version allowing self-online registration through Internet Banking or Debit Card. It reduces TAT and eliminates mandate rejections due to signature mismatch.

english: What is the Virtual Account Number (VAN) collection product and how does it work?
tamil_english: VAN collection product enna? Ithu epdi work panratha?
hindi_english: VAN collection product kya hai aur yeh kaise kaam karta hai?
ground_truth: VAN (Virtual Account Number) enables collections using unique alphanumeric codes instead of account numbers, supporting RTGS/NEFT/Cheques/Cash, with multiple VANs mappable to one collection account and real-time MIS.

english: What is the Digi Dealer product and which app is used to access it?
tamil_english: Digi Dealer product enna? Ithai access panna enna app use pannanum?
hindi_english: Digi Dealer product kya hai aur ise access karne ke liye kaunsa app use hota hai?
ground_truth: Digi Dealer is a mobile application for fast and secure Cash and SBI Cheque deposition, accessible through the Yono Business App on Google Play Store.

english: What payment options does SBI offer for corporate dividend payouts?
tamil_english: Corporate dividend payouts-ku SBI enna enna payment options offer panranga?
hindi_english: Corporate dividend payouts ke liye SBI kaunse payment options offer karta hai?
ground_truth: Dividend payouts can be made using RTGS/NEFT, DCR, DW, DD, SWIFT, and Dollar DDs, with instant return and reconciliation reports available.

english: What is the CCPAP instrument and what is the maximum facsimile signature limit for it?
tamil_english: CCPAP instrument enna? Atha facsimile signature limit evvalavu?
hindi_english: CCPAP instrument kya hai aur iske liye facsimile signature limit kitna hai?
ground_truth: CCPAP (Corporate Cheque Payable At Par) is a multicity cheque with online validation. Facsimile signature-based instruments are valid up to Rs 100 Lacs.

english: How does SBI's Liquidity Management product help corporates?
tamil_english: SBI Liquidity Management product corporates-ku epdi help panratha?
hindi_english: SBI ka Liquidity Management product corporates ki kaise help karta hai?
ground_truth: It allows corporates to sweep funds from main accounts to sub-accounts as needed and reverse-sweep unused funds, facilitating interest saving and efficient fund management.

english: What are the payment channels supported by SBI's e-payments product for salary disbursements?
tamil_english: Salary disburse panna SBI e-payments product enna enna channels support panratha?
hindi_english: Salary disburse karne ke liye SBI e-payments product kaunse channels support karta hai?
ground_truth: SBI's e-payments product supports RTGS, NEFT, and Direct Credit (DC) for faster settlement of payables like salary and commission, with a single file format for all payment types.

english: Is training offered to microfinance borrowers free of charge?
tamil_english: Microfinance borrowers-ku kudukka padra training free of cost-aa irukka?
hindi_english: Kya microfinance borrowers ko diya jaane wala training free hota hai?
ground_truth: Yes, any training offered to microfinance borrowers by the bank shall be free of cost.

english: Can field staff recover microfinance loan dues at the borrower's home?
tamil_english: Field staff borrower veetla poi microfinance loan dues collect pannalama?
hindi_english: Kya field staff borrower ke ghar jaake microfinance loan recovery kar sakta hai?
ground_truth: Yes, field staff may recover at the borrower's residence if the account is irregular, if the borrower has missed two consecutive branch visits, or at the borrower's request.

english: What verification must be done before engaging recovery agents for microfinance loans?
tamil_english: Microfinance loan recovery agents engage panna enna verification panna vendam?
hindi_english: Microfinance loan ke liye recovery agents engage karne se pehle kya verification karni padti hai?
ground_truth: The bank must conduct due diligence on recovery agents including police verification of antecedents of all individuals involved in the recovery process, with periodic re-verification.

english: What does the SBI code say employees should do when they discover wrongdoing?
tamil_english: Oru employee wrongdoing paartha SBI code enna panna soluchu?
hindi_english: SBI code kehta hai ki kisi wrongdoing ka pata chalne par employee kya kare?
ground_truth: Employees should speak up and report wrongdoing. The bank strictly prohibits retaliation against anyone who reports legitimate concerns.

english: Is insider trading allowed for SBI employees or their family members?
tamil_english: SBI employees ya athoda family members insider trading pannalama?
hindi_english: Kya SBI employees ya unke family members insider trading kar sakte hain?
ground_truth: Insider trading is strictly prohibited for SBI employees and their family members or close acquaintances. Inadvertent disclosure must be immediately reported.

english: What types of IT assets does SBI classify as bank assets under the Code of Ethics?
tamil_english: SBI Code of Ethics-la bank IT assets endha endha classify panranga?
hindi_english: SBI Code of Ethics mein bank ke IT assets mein kya kya shamil hai?
ground_truth: IT assets include computer hardware, software, and other information and alternate channel systems.

english: How many SBI branches is the Power Jyoti product designed to work across?
tamil_english: Power Jyoti product evvalavu SBI branches-la work aagum?
hindi_english: Power Jyoti product kitne SBI branches mein kaam karta hai?
ground_truth: Power Jyoti is designed to work across 22,000+ SBI branches nationwide.

english: Can multiple VANs be assigned to a single pooling account in the Collection VAN product?
tamil_english: Collection VAN product-la oru pooling account-ku multiple VANs assign pannalama?
hindi_english: Collection VAN product mein ek pooling account par multiple VANs assign kiye ja sakte hain kya?
ground_truth: Yes, multiple VANs can be mapped to a single collection account in the Collection VAN product.

english: What channels can be used to deposit premium amounts through SBI's Easy Collect product?
tamil_english: SBI Easy Collect-la premium amount enga enga deposit panna mudiyum?
hindi_english: SBI Easy Collect product mein premium amount kaunse channels se deposit kar sakte hain?
ground_truth: Premiums can be deposited via Cash, SBI-drawn Cheques, and Other Bank Cheques payable in local clearing at all 22,000+ SBI branches.

english: What does the SBI code say about giving gifts to government officials?
tamil_english: Government officials-ku gift kudukka SBI code enna solranga?
hindi_english: SBI code mein government officials ko gifts dene ke baare mein kya likha hai?
ground_truth: SBI employees must not give gifts to government officials under any circumstances.

english: What happens if a bank's outsourced agency behaves inappropriately with microfinance borrowers?
tamil_english: Outsourced agency microfinance borrowers kitta wrong-aa nadanthukinaanga, bank enna பண்ண vendam?
hindi_english: Agar outsourced agency microfinance borrowers ke saath galat behave kare to bank ki kya zimmedari hai?
ground_truth: Outsourcing does not reduce the bank's obligations. The bank is fully accountable for inappropriate behavior by its employees or outsourced agencies and must provide timely grievance redressal.

english: How does SBI's transaction banking MIS help corporate clients?
tamil_english: SBI transaction banking MIS corporate clients-ku epdi help panratha?
hindi_english: SBI transaction banking ka MIS corporate clients ki kaise help karta hai?
ground_truth: Customized daily and monthly MIS reports facilitate easy and effective reconciliation of transactions for corporate clients, with secure portal-based access.

english: If a microfinance borrower is struggling to repay, what restructuring options does the bank policy allow?
tamil_english: Microfinance borrower repay panna kashtapattaa, bank policy enna restructuring options kudukka solranga?
hindi_english: Agar microfinance borrower repay karna mushkil ho, to bank policy mein kya restructuring options hain?
ground_truth: The bank can restructure the repayment schedule or provide a flexible repayment tenure beyond the contractual 36 months. Such relaxation can be granted up to a maximum of 24 additional months.

english: What SBI green bond project had the highest amount allocated as of March 2025?
tamil_english: SBI green bond-la March 2025 vara highest allocation patta project enna?
hindi_english: March 2025 tak SBI green bond mein sabse zyada amount kaunse project ko allocate kiya gaya?
ground_truth: Ayana Renewable Power One Private Limited received the highest allocation of Rs 1091.18 crore.
source: ee9a3135_Impact Reporting of Green Bond of USD 250 Million.pdf

english: What was the total CO2 emission abated by SBI's green bond projects?
tamil_english: SBI green bond projects-la total CO2 emission evvalavu reduce aachathu?
hindi_english: SBI green bond projects se total kitna CO2 emission kam hua?
ground_truth: The projects cumulatively abated 4.38 million metric tons of CO2 equivalent per annum.
source: ee9a3135_Impact Reporting of Green Bond of USD 250 Million.pdf

english: When did SBI raise the USD 250 million green bond and when does it mature?
tamil_english: SBI USD 250 million green bond endha date-la raise pannaanga? Maturity endha date?
hindi_english: SBI ne USD 250 million green bond kab raise kiya aur uski maturity kab hai?
ground_truth: The green bond was raised on December 29, 2023 and matures on December 29, 2028.
source: ee9a3135_Impact Reporting of Green Bond of USD 250 Million.pdf
